annotation.cut_point:
Let the three-digit number be $ x $. Then, when multiplied by 7, the product is:

$$
7x = \text{product} = \text{a number with digits 6, 3, 8 following the thousands place}
$$

Since the number has three digits, the product must be a 4-digit number: 6380.
